fold_selection: first and last canonical IDSSE indices; two competitions; fixed before new held-out evaluation; not chosen by test score
checkpoint_selection: lowest own-inner-validation masked loss within cap; cap/condition selected by robust validation score with frozen phase3 decoder
initial_resume: reconstruct private DataLoader generator; replay cap6 to cap12 and compare model, optimizer and torch RNG exactly before extending; save every new epoch with complete RNG state
decoder_source: each fold's phase3 validation-selected condition, seed2027; cached validation/test probabilities; no neural training
test_policy: freeze all per-fold selections before reading that fold's new test emissions/labels; report all inner-selected family finalists; no selection from test
limitations: research on the previously observed seven-match IDSSE cohort; new extensions are exploratory, not a new untouched confirmatory dataset
